description: Grid snapshot for one market: average operational carbon intensity (gCO2/kWh, derived from the fuel mix, not measured), a modelled wholesale price baseline (USD/MWh; no live price feed exists in any market), fuel mix, demand and capacity (MW), a system-level firm margin (NOT local connectable capacity) and peak stress (%). Read field_provenance before quoting a number. Responses from API schema 1.1 onward also carry figures.{field} = {value, unit, as_of (ISO date or month), source, method, confidence, stable_id, report_url}: when present, quote the unit and as_of from it, and a null value there carries figures.{field}.absence -- insufficient_evidence (not enough evidence), structurally_unavailable (does not exist there, e.g. no wholesale market), not_collected (exists, not held) or withheld (paid) -- with reason_text; report which one. Older responses have no figures object: take the unit from the field name or field_provenance and the date from as_of. Either way, never report an absent value as zero; say it is not held.

market.description: Market id (public slug), e.g. 'ontario', 'ercot', 'ireland'. Use pgiq_markets to list ids.

name: pgiq_grid
